quarterly_data.signal: Ferrotec's board resolved on October 20, 2026 that its subsidiary Hangzhou Dahe Thermo-Magnetics Electronics (FTH) will raise its stake in equity-method affiliate Anhui Boxinwei Semiconductor Technology (AMTD), a Chinese maker of aluminum showerheads and other dedicated equipment parts for semiconductor tools, from 20.3% to 67.6% by acquiring Hangzhou Bori Technology's interest for cash (46.7% in the text; the shareholder table lists Hangzhou Bori at 47.3%), making AMTD a consolidated subsidiary (a specified subsidiary); AMTD shareholders' meeting planned October 30, 2026 and share transfer planned November 30, 2026. Stated reason: Hangzhou Bori, a seller of clinical laboratory analyzers and diagnostic reagents whose largest shareholder is Ferrotec president He Xianhan (49.51%), agreed to transfer the business to FTH because semiconductor-related business is not its main business; adding AMTD's aluminum showerheads and other products to Ferrotec's lineup is expected to raise revenue from its semiconductor-equipment-maker customers. AMTD (established June 24, 2024) recorded net sales of JPY 478,872 thousand and an operating loss of JPY 352,110 thousand in the fiscal year ended March 2026. The company expects the impact on this fiscal year's results to be minor.
